info.description: A head-to-head voting app where users compare two items and see how everyone else voted.
info.process: The app runs on a split runtime: Amplify hosts the Next.js frontend and API routes, while a standalone Node service on EC2 handles only the WebSocket layer. That service keeps active rooms in memory, persists snapshots to MongoDB so players can reconnect and rehydrate state after a drop, and broadcasts vote updates to everyone in a room as they happen.
info.outcome: Separating the socket runtime from the app host keeps the EC2 side lightweight, no Next.js build or dependency surface required, while Amplify handles the deploys it's actually built for. Rooms expire automatically after 30 minutes and idle in-memory sessions get cleaned up shortly after everyone disconnects, so the service stays lean without manual upkeep.

info.description: A discovery tool that surfaces new video games from a plain-language description of what you feel like playing.
info.process: A user's plain-language mood or preference gets sent to an AWS Lambda function, which queries the IGDB API for candidate games and passes that data to an LLM to reason about which titles actually fit what was asked for.
info.outcome: The result is a short list of game suggestions, each paired with a plain explanation of why it matches, turning a vague "something like X but more chill" into concrete picks without manually filtering storefronts or wikis.

info.description: A trip planner that turns a list of stops into a mapped, bookable itinerary.
info.process: The backend is an Express.js API with a modular controller/service/model structure: Mongoose schemas cover trips, travelers, supplies, values, and route details, Auth0 handles authentication on protected routes, and Socket.IO powers real-time updates between travelers on the same trip.
info.outcome: The API exposes full CRUD across trips, travelers, supplies, and route waypoints behind Auth0-gated endpoints, with a real-time layer so changes one traveler makes show up live for the rest of the group.
